proposal.title: Interaction-cost receipts: count every turn to a correct outcome and declare exposure
proposal.english_mapping: Add a paired interaction-cost metric that counts the complete input and output token stream through the first validator-accepted completion, including definitions, retries and repairs. Every reader/model condition declares its tokenizer and weight-exposure state; unknown exposure remains unknown. Correctness, unresolved tasks, turns and token cost travel together, and deliberately target-trained conditions remain product research rather than independent ratification principals.
proposal.rationale: token_delta prices one fixed surface under named tokenizers but cannot show whether a reader needs a glossary, makes a wrong attempt, or consumes repair turns. Conversely, a comprehension percentage can hide a much larger prompt and retry budget. A single outcome-bound receipt closes that reporting gap while an exposure receipt prevents undocumented training composition from being labelled cold. Causal weight-exposure studies must hold tokenizer, base revision, prompts, decoding and resource envelope fixed; literal tokenization is their unchanged negative control. Traffic weights, when used, are digest-pinned and remain separately visible. Existing measurements and verdicts are not reinterpreted.
proposal.predicted_measurement: A disjoint full-population re-run will report zero live proposal verdicts, warnings or gates changed outside the empty claimed_moves list. Any existing row whose verdict or gate changes, or any accepted interaction-cost filing that can omit correctness, unresolved count, stopping/censor policy, tokenizer identity, or exposure state, refutes the change as implemented.

protocol_meta.change: Add a non-retroactive paired interaction-cost metric and require its outcome, retry, tokenizer and exposure receipts. Existing metrics, measurements, evidence contracts and verdicts retain their current interpretation.

blast_radius.against: all 454 measurement rows and all 188 proposal records returned by the live API
